grid_reconstruction.formula: E / (E - eligible_fc1 - eligible_patch + sum_i(fc1_cycle_i * kept_i / baseline_i) + sum_j(patch_cycle_j * kept_j / baseline_j))

aggregate_shortcut_attack.assessment: The shortcut does not change this grid's decisions but is not the accepted formula; paper tables must retain the per-module cycle-weighted denominator.

population_alignment_attack.assessment: Both islands multiply M51 predicate fractions by M221 cycle weights. Exact arithmetic does not remove the population mismatch.

findings.title: The combined exact grid still projects M51 predicates onto M221 cycle populations
findings.evidence: FC1 differs by +0.45336% in aggregate and up to 3.26616% by module; patch-Conv differs by +3.08975% in aggregate and up to 4.61321% by module.
findings.impact: The 1.1841687x result is an exact ideal sensitivity conditional on cross-population scaling, not a same-population performance measurement.
findings.required_fix: Replay both predicates on the exact frozen-ledger population, or regenerate both task and cycle ledgers from one sealed population before promotion.

findings.title: The 1.1841687x denominator contains no executable shared-island overhead
findings.evidence: M300 scales useful source work but has no mask fetch, group-decision, router, bank-conflict, scan, commit, SRAM or control-cycle adapter. The candidate has 15.564M projected-cycle or 2.971% denominator margin before dropping below 1.15.
findings.impact: Unmodeled overhead may consume the margin; this is not executable cycle, RTL or system speedup evidence.
findings.required_fix: After an accuracy pass, implement a cycle adapter with explicit per-module schedules and all shared-island overheads, then compare against the same-resource baseline.

findings.title: Low-budget is justified only as the lowest beta in the enumerated grid
findings.evidence: No beta below 48 crosses 1.15 and only group4 crosses at beta48, but the point removes 32.37% of FC1 and 37.02% of patch activity-weighted tasks.
findings.impact: The label does not establish low accuracy risk, low normalized error or low deletion.
findings.required_fix: Use the phrase lowest-beta enumerated crossing until the paired S10 result establishes the error budget.

findings.title: Beta0 exactness is a DSE task identity, not yet a modified-forward or hardware identity
findings.evidence: All five beta0 cells preserve baseline task counts and reconstruct sensitivity 1 exactly, but no sealed modified-forward beta0 prediction digest or hardware bypass trace is bound.
findings.impact: The mathematical baseline does not by itself prove implementation transparency.
findings.required_fix: Require paired beta0 baseline/modified-forward prediction identity and later a bypass-cycle identity test.

findings.title: FC1 and patch raw INT8 bounds cannot be summed or compared as network error
findings.evidence: At group4/beta48 the separate maxima are 9,936 and 21,504 in distinct per-destination raw accumulator domains with different row scales.
findings.impact: Their sum is neither a dequantized float bound nor an AEE/accuracy guarantee.
findings.required_fix: Keep both bounds separate; if used beyond overflow screening, bind per-row scales and propagate them through BN/ATLIF semantics.

next_action: Keep group4/beta48 as the sole paired-S10 candidate. If and only if S10 passes the sealed accuracy gate, replay both predicates on the same population and build the explicit shared-island executable cycle adapter before any RTL or paper-speedup promotion.
